name: varg-character-design
description: How to make AI characters people remember, on varg: define the character (premise, archetype, contrast), write the details (face, body, age, flaws, one signature detail), dress them (garment by garment, materials, fit, one loud colour), pick a category recipe, then lock the look in a character sheet and reuse it in later images and videos (Nano Banana, Seedream, GPT Image, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3). Use when someone asks to create, design or describe a character, an AI influencer or persona, a mascot, a character sheet or turnaround, or the same character in new scenes or videos. Category recipes: varg-character-grandma, varg-character-big-guy, varg-character-cringe, varg-character-beautiful-woman, varg-character-fitness, varg-character-absurd, varg-character-cartoon. Not for multi-scene ads from real actor photos (varg-consistent-characters), a speaker on a stage (varg-character-keynote) or two-person podcasts (varg-podcast-video).
